# konnect_org_notification_destination (Resource)

OrgNotificationDestination Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_org_notification_destination" "my_orgnotificationdestination" {
  http = {
    custom_headers = {
      key = "value"
    }
    name = "...my_name..."
    type = "http"
    url  = "...my_url..."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `http` (Attributes) An HTTP destination with its new plaintext signing secret. The signing secret is returned only when a destination is created. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--http))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `custom_header_names` (List of String) Names of the configured custom headers. Header values are not returned.
- `id` (String) UUID v7 identifier of the destination.
- `last_failure_at` (String) Time of the most recent failed notification delivery, if any.
- `last_failure_reason` (String) Reason for the most recent failed notification delivery, if any.
- `last_success_at` (String) Time of the most recent successful notification delivery, if any.
- `name` (String) Name of the destination.
- `signing_algo` (String) Signing algorithm of the signing key.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret used to verify that an HTTP notification was sent by Kong.
- `state` (String) Destination status. pending_verification means the destination is waiting for verification; enabled means it can receive notifications; disabled means it is paused; disabled_system means it was disabled automatically.
- `type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity update date.
- `url` (String) Endpoint URL of the destination.
- `url_host` (String) Host part of the target URL.
- `verified_at` (String) Time when the destination was verified, if verification is complete.

<a id="nestedatt--http"></a>
### Nested Schema for `http`

Optional:

- `custom_headers` (Map of String) Custom headers to include in notification requests. You can set up to 10 headers.
The Standard Webhooks headers and the transport headers are reserved.
- `name` (String) Destination name. The name must contain 1 to 255 characters after leading and trailing spaces are removed. Not Null
- `type` (String) Destination type. This value must match the type set when the destination was created. You cannot change the destination type. Not Null; must be "http"
- `url` (String) Full URL of the endpoint that receives notifications.
Must be a publicly resolvable address.
Not Null

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_org_notification_destination.my_konnect_org_notification_destination
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_org_notification_destination.my_konnect_org_notification_destination "..."
```
